data.name: EXTERM
data.detailed_description:
Something has moved into the places people abandoned. You and up to three others have been hired to deal with it. Not to study it. Not to run from it. To wipe it out — and grab everything worth taking on the way.

The Job

EXTERM is a co-op horror extraction game. Sign the contract, pile into the van, and get dropped into a different cursed site every run. The quota is simple and doesn't care about your excuses: grab what's on the list, kill what's marked for extermination. Hit both, or you don't get paid — and the longer you stick around, the more the place starts paying attention to you.

Features

  • Two jobs, one paycheck. You're scavenger and hunter both — loot the valuables, take down the elite monster stalking the map. Come up short on either number and walking away early isn't on the table.

  • A bestiary that hits back. Every map spawns its own mix of regular and elite monsters, each with its own logic — things that watch from the dark, things that wear a friendly face, things that just come for you. Learn how they work, or become dinner.

  • Never the same run twice. Rooms, layouts, and loot get rebuilt from scratch every time you drop in. No memorizing the map. No safe runs.

  • Built for up to four. Split up, coordinate, panic, die together — co-op is what separates a full van from an empty one.

  • Get back to the van. It's the only way out. Bring the haul back, bring your crew back, and try to do both at once.

Clock in. Fill the quota. Try to clock out.

data.short_description: Co-op horror extraction for up to 4. Pest control for things that shouldn't exist. Fill your quota: loot the haul, exterminate the elites, reach the van alive. Procedurally generated maps, each with monsters all their own.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD FX-6300 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 (2 GB) / AMD RX 560 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Microphone recommended for proximity voice
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6 GB) / AMD RX 580 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Microphone recommended for proximity voice

content_descriptors.notes: EXTERM is a co-op horror game with a realistic, frightening atmosphere. Players explore dark environments while being hunted by hostile creatures, and player characters can be killed during gameplay. The game does not contain sexual content or substance abuse themes.
